#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int R, C;
    cin >> R >> C;
    if (R > C) {
        swap(R, C);
    }

    // dp[c][m1][m2] = min spiders in first c columns
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(C + 1, vector<vector<int>>(1 << R, vector<int>(1 << R, 69)));
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << R); ++mask) {
        dp[0][0][mask] = 0;
    }

    for (int c = 1; c <= C; ++c) {
        for (int mask1 = 0; mask1 < (1 << R); ++mask1) {
            for (int mask2 = 0; mask2 < (1 << R); ++mask2) {
                for (int mask3 = 0; mask3 < (1 << R); ++mask3) {
                    bool works = true;
                    for (int b = 0; b < R; ++b) {
                        if ((mask2 & (1 << b)) == 0) {
                            bool ok = false;
                            if (b > 0 && (mask2 & (1 << (b - 1))) != 0) ok = true;
                            if (!ok && b + 1 < R && (mask2 & (1 << (b + 1))) != 0) ok = true;
                            if (!ok && (mask1 & (1 << b)) != 0) ok = true;
                            if (!ok && (mask3 & (1 << b)) != 0) ok = true;
                            if (!ok) {
                                works = false;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (works) {
                        dp[c][mask2][mask3] = min(dp[c][mask2][mask3], dp[c-1][mask1][mask2] + __builtin_popcount(mask1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int res = 0;
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << R); ++mask) {
        res = max(res, R * C - (dp[C][mask][0] + __builtin_popcount(mask)));
    }
    cout << res << "\n";

    return 0;
}
